[#io_arconia_rewrite_openapi_swagger_UpgradeSwaggerCore_3]
=== Migrate to Swagger Core 3.x
`io.arconia.rewrite.openapi.swagger.UpgradeSwaggerCore_3`

Migrate a Java application to the latest Swagger Core 3.x release, including the move to Jackson 3. Swagger Core 3 supports only the `jakarta` namespace. The recipe migrates a project only when its code uses no `javax` REST, Servlet, Bean Validation, or JAXB APIs and it doesn't declare the `javax` variant of the Swagger REST artifacts, and otherwise leaves the project unchanged, so it is never left half migrated. In a multi-module build, each module is checked on its own.

_Tags: swagger_

*Example*

.Before
[source,java]
----
import io.swagger.v3.jaxrs2.integration.JaxrsOpenApiContextBuilder;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.OpenApiConfigurationException;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.SwaggerConfiguration;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.api.OpenApiContext;

class OpenApiSetup {
    OpenApiContext context() throws OpenApiConfigurationException {
        SwaggerConfiguration configuration = new SwaggerConfiguration()
                .scannerClass("io.swagger.v3.jaxrs2.integration.JaxrsAnnotationScanner");
        return new JaxrsOpenApiContextBuilder<>()
                .openApiConfiguration(configuration)
                .buildContext(true);
    }
}
----

.After
[source,java]
----
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.OpenApiConfigurationException;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.SwaggerConfiguration;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.api.OpenApiContext;
import io.swagger.v3.rest.integration.RestOpenApiContextBuilder;

class OpenApiSetup {
    OpenApiContext context() throws OpenApiConfigurationException {
        SwaggerConfiguration configuration = new SwaggerConfiguration()
                .scannerClass("io.swagger.v3.rest.integration.RestAnnotationScanner");
        return new RestOpenApiContextBuilder<>()
                .openApiConfiguration(configuration)
                .buildContext(true);
    }
}
----

[#io_arconia_rewrite_openapi_swagger_FindProjectsWithoutJavaxSwaggerArtifacts]
=== Find projects that declare no `javax` Swagger REST artifacts
`io.arconia.rewrite.openapi.swagger.FindProjectsWithoutJavaxSwaggerArtifacts`

Find the source files of a project that declares none of `swagger-jaxrs2`, `swagger-jaxrs2-servlet-initializer`, or `swagger-jaxrs2-servlet-initializer-v2`, the `javax` variants of the Swagger REST artifacts. Swagger Core 3 supports only the `jakarta` namespace, so a project that declares them does not qualify. The artifacts brought in by a third-party library don't count.

[#io_arconia_rewrite_openapi_swagger_FindProjectsWithoutJavaxEnterpriseApis]
=== Find projects that use no `javax` Jakarta EE APIs read by Swagger Core
`io.arconia.rewrite.openapi.swagger.FindProjectsWithoutJavaxEnterpriseApis`

Find the source files of a project whose code uses none of the `javax` REST, Servlet, Bean Validation, or JAXB APIs. Swagger Core 3 supports only the `jakarta` namespace, so a project that still uses them does not qualify.

[#io_arconia_rewrite_openapi_swagger_ChangeObjectMapperProcessorMethods]
=== Return the mapper from `ObjectMapperProcessor` methods
`io.arconia.rewrite.openapi.swagger.ChangeObjectMapperProcessorMethods`

Change the `void` methods of `ObjectMapperProcessor` implementations to return the `ObjectMapper` they receive, as the Swagger Core 3 interface expects, and remove the deprecated `processYamlObjectMapper` method, which Swagger Core no longer calls. A method that configures the mapper in place still needs to build a new one with `mapper.rebuild()`, since Jackson 3 mappers are immutable.

*Example*

.Before
[source,java]
----
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.api.ObjectMapperProcessor;

class IndentingProcessor implements ObjectMapperProcessor {
    @Override
    public void processJsonObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        mapper.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
    }

    @Override
    public void processOutputJsonObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
    }

    @Override
    public void processOutputYamlObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        if (mapper.isEnabled(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT)) {
            return;
        }
        mapper.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
    }
}
----

.After
[source,java]
----
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.integration.api.ObjectMapperProcessor;

class IndentingProcessor implements ObjectMapperProcessor {
    @Override
    public ObjectMapper processJsonObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        mapper.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
        return mapper;
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectMapper processOutputJsonObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        return mapper;
    }

    @Override
    public ObjectMapper processOutputYamlObjectMapper(ObjectMapper mapper) {
        if (mapper.isEnabled(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT)) {
            return mapper;
        }
        mapper.enable(SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT);
        return mapper;
    }
}
----
